blocks.title: Prisma | Next-generation ORM for Node.js & TypeScript
blocks.description: Prisma is a next-generation Node.js and TypeScript ORM for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB, and CockroachDB. It provides type-safety, automated migrations, and an intuitive data model.

blocks.title: DrizzleORM - next gen TypeScript ORM
blocks.description: Drizzle ORM is a lightweight and performant TypeScript ORM with developer experience in mind

blocks.title: Kysely | Kysely
blocks.description: Kysely let's you write type-safe SQL queries. This eliminates entire classes of errors and let's you sleep peacefully at night.

blocks.title: MikroORM: TypeScript ORM for Node.js based on Data Mapper, Unit of Work and Identity Map patterns. | MikroORM
blocks.description: TypeScript ORM for Node.js based on Data Mapper, Unit of Work and Identity Map patterns.

blocks.title: Mongoose ODM v8.1.1
blocks.description: Let's face it, writing MongoDB validation, casting and business logic boilerplate is a drag. That's why we wrote Mongoose.

blocks.title: Sequelize
blocks.description: Sequelize is a modern TypeScript and Node.js ORM for Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and SQL Server, and more. Featuring solid transaction support, relations, eager and lazy loading, read replication and more.

blocks.title: The ultimate ORM for Node and Typescript
blocks.description: Fetch rows directly in the browser. Developer friendly, concise with with powerful filtering.
